title: Task management app — teams, boards, due dates

define.note: Approved by the user at the gate on 2026-09-03, after being shown the no-password-reset risk and the polling-vs-push resolution. Fresh-eyes pass fixed 6 defects before presentation (SC5 auth-leak ambiguity, SC10 flaky timing window, SC11 unprovable claim, unspecified session lifetime, no leave-team path, silent column-delete cascade).

design.note: REVISED 2026-09-04 from design-refs/board-reference.png, treated as direction not a pixel target. Adopted (visual only, no new capability): five-hue accent scale cycled BY COLUMN POSITION (no new field; restates I3; stable across reloads), coloured card titles, roomier density (320px columns, 14px card padding), three-band card anatomy, initials avatar stack replacing comma-separated names, pill count chips, flat-fill depth strategy. Contrast COMPUTED not estimated (design-refs/contrast.py, validated black-on-white=21.00): every ink/surface pair 5.00-5.04. Two findings: --muted-foreground drops to 4.21 on tinted cards so a --tint-muted-foreground 0.500 token was added (5.34); and the due-date badges were re-solved against all five tints at once, not one card surface. NOT adopted: 10 items that are FEATURES not in spec.md (tags, progress bars, checklists, attachments, thumbnails, search, suite nav, collapsible columns, photo avatars, times on cards) — listed in design.md's appendix as scope questions AWAITING THE USER'S DECISION. Adopting any of them amends spec.md, which is gated. No code was changed by this run.

blueprint.note: plan.md approved by the user at the gate on 2026-09-04 (intake Q18), after being shown the Step 1b dependency findings and decision D1. Two open Shape choices were settled at the same gate: T03 session storage = DB-backed session table (Q19); T10 drag library = @hello-pangea/dnd (Q20). Both folded into plan.md. Fresh-eyes pass had fixed 3 defects before presentation.

construct.note: ALL 19 plan slices done (T01-T18 + T10a). Proving set green and re-run at close: lint exit 0 · 171 unit+integration (also green under UTC, America/Los_Angeles, Asia/Tokyo) · 57 e2e · build exit 0 · zero schema drift. All 11 success criteria and all 7 invariants have test references. ~45 mutants introduced across the run; every one killed after correcting three that had not actually applied.

verify.note: PASS after finding and fixing 3 defects. Proving set re-run fresh: lint 0 · 178 unit+integration (green under LA and Tokyo) · 61 e2e no flakes · build 0. Database pack: migration up 0.77s/10 tables; NO down path exists (finding). Prod-shaped volume 480 tasks: polled board query p50 4.4ms, 4 SQL statements, no N+1. Browser gates: zero console errors AND warnings across the core flow, every control named, keyboard completable. 18 adversarial probes: 16/18 first run, 18/18 after fixes, 3 consecutive runs, zero server errors. DEFECTS FIXED: (1) null byte in any text field -> 500 (P2039), fixed with one storable-text rule across 9 routes; (2) concurrent member removal -> 500 (P2025), fixed with idempotent deleteMany; (3) concurrent task moves -> 500 (P2034 write conflict), fixed with a bounded retry — the most consequential, since concurrent dragging is the core collaborative action. Each root-caused before any fix and pinned with a failing test first.

harden.note: Audit + two fix passes + re-audit. At audit: 1 Critical, 1 High, 4 Medium, 4 Info. NOW ALL CLOSED: 0/0/0/0. Pass 1 fixed C1 (login throttle — 96-97 of 100 attempts refused, cooldown proven to elapse so it is not a lockout DoS), H1 (signup throttled, message kept), I1/I2/I3. Pass 2 fixed all four Mediums: M1 six security headers + CSP (console-clean gate proves it does not break the app; CSP keeps unsafe-inline for script, documented, nonce needs middleware); M2 Origin check made STRUCTURAL — handleErrors now takes the request as a required argument so a new route cannot compile without it, plus a completeness test over the route files; M3 shadcn moved to devDependencies; M4 90-day absolute session cap never refreshed, plus sign-out-everywhere. M4 also closed an unlisted gap: there was NO way to sign out at all — endpoint existed, no UI. Regression: 18/18 adversarial probes, 202 unit/integration, 67 e2e over three consecutive runs.

open_items_for_resume: NEXT PHASE: inspect, then release (GO/NO-GO gate). harden is fully closed — 0 findings at any severity.

DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (not a finding): the CSP permits inline script, so it is not XSS-proof. Tightening to a per-request nonce needs a middleware layer this app does not have. Recorded in next.config.ts.
FINDING (verify): no schema rollback path — three migrations now exist, so this matters from here on.
FINDING (verify): polled board payload 122 KB on a 360-task board (p50 4.4ms). Measured, within tolerance.
KNOWN MVP RISK, ACCEPTED: no password reset. Sign-out-everywhere is now the only self-service recovery for a suspected stolen session.
